The '''TIE Advanced combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s. It had an engraving of a TIE/ad starfighter.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the TIE/ad's armament of concussion missiles as well as proton rockets. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of an operation dealing with a raid on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base and wiping out its fighter complement. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as a reenactment of a mission escorting the cargo ship ''[[Rasvin]]'' to the ''[[Laantis]]''.

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the TIE/ad shortly after the starfighter line [[Arms Race|entered mass production]].
